prerequisites: Acquisition of competencies from subjects in the Degree in Mechanical Engineering is recommended: Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Business, Chemistry, Graphic Expression, Thermal Engineering, Machines and Mechanisms, Solid Mechanics, Fluid Mechanics, Materials Science and Engineering, Mechanical Technology, Automation, Fundamental Electronics, Electrical Engineering.
Acquisition of competencies from subjects in the first three years of the Degree in Mechanical Engineering is recommended.

syllabus_topics: Block I. Student application and selection process by administration, institution, or company
Training seminar on company internships: administrative and/or management part of the internships (1 h).
Block II. Execution of curricular internships in the company or institution
Execution of the work to be performed in the selected Administration/Company (235 h).
Follow-up with the academic tutor, professional tutor, and course coordinator (2 h).
Block III. Elaboration of the final report on the execution of company internships
Training seminar on the elaboration of the final internship report (1h).
Presentation of the final company internship report (1h).
teaching_methods: Procedure demonstration in a professional setting
Follow-up activities (through tutorials with the academic tutor)
Learning to use the IT tool developed by the University of Almería for internship management
Consulting virtual course documentation for curricular internships
Performing the external internship, learning the work dynamics of the selected company and adapting acquired competencies to the specific work
Preparing follow-up sessions with academic and professional tutors, providing necessary documentation
Developing the follow-up report proposed by the University Employment Service
Preparing the final report for curricular internships and modifying it based on tutor comments

assessment_methods.method: Academic tutor's evaluation of the internship report

assessment_rules: Students must pass the occupational risk prevention (PRL) course before starting the internship. Attendance at the company or institution is mandatory. A minimum of 2.5 points from the company's evaluation and 1.5 points from the academic tutor's evaluation report must be achieved. If any competency is not acquired according to the company and/or academic tutor's assessment, the final grade will be 'Fail', and the School of Engineering will determine how to recover it.
